## Functions

### `NumberInput`

```ts
NumberInput(props: NumberInputProps): Html
```

A native `<input type="number">` between a − and a + stepper. The
browser's own spin buttons are hidden; the steppers call `stepDown()`/
`stepUp()` (number-input.js), hold to repeat, and grey out at `min`/`max`.
Without JS the input is still a number field with keyboard stepping.

## Types

### `NumberInputSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `NumberInputFormat`

`plain` shows the value as typed; `group` shows thousands separators
(number-input.js formats the field on blur with `Intl.NumberFormat` and
restores the raw value on focus — what submits is always the raw
number, and without JS the field is plain).

- `"plain"`
- `"group"`

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Seats on a plan

```ts
FormField({
  id: "seats",
  label: "Seats",
  control: NumberInput({ id: "seats", name: "seats", value: 5, min: 1, max: 500, required: true }),
})
```

```html
<div class="form-field">
  <label class="form-field__label" for="seats">Seats</label>
  <div class="number-input" data-number-input>
    <button type="button" class="number-input__step" data-number-step="down" aria-label="Decrease" tabindex="-1">
      <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </button>
    <input class="input number-input__field" type="number" inputmode="decimal" id="seats" name="seats" value="5" min="1" max="500" required="">
    <button type="button" class="number-input__step" data-number-step="up" aria-label="Increase" tabindex="-1">
      <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </button>
  </div>
</div>
```

### A budget with thousands separators

`format: "group"` shows `125,000` while the field is not focused; the raw number is what submits.

```ts
NumberInput({ id: "budget", name: "budget", value: 125000, step: 500, min: 0, unit: "USD", format: "group" })
```

```html
<div class="number-input" data-number-input data-number-group="">
  <button type="button" class="number-input__step" data-number-step="down" aria-label="Decrease" tabindex="-1">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </button>
  <input class="input number-input__field" type="number" inputmode="decimal" id="budget" name="budget" value="125000" min="0" step="500">
  <span class="number-input__unit">USD</span>
  <button type="button" class="number-input__step" data-number-step="up" aria-label="Increase" tabindex="-1">
    <svg width="14" height="14" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </button>
</div>
```

## Behaviour

`components/number-input/number-input.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-number-group`, `data-number-input`, `data-number-step`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
